sections.label: ASSISTANT
sections.content: I've identified that the arrows control the divider by default in level 2, and SPACE switches control to the piece. Since the rows are already aligned, I need to move the divider 9 left to shift the gray piece into the correct position. I'll test this by pressing SPACE then LEFT to verify the divider moves before committing to the full sequence.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bb(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,ch in [('P','B'),('G','c'),('Y','Y'),('D','S')]:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(0,63) for c in range(0,63) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not cells: out[name]=None; continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        out[name]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    return out
s0=bb(current_frame)
action(['SPACE'])
action(['LEFT'])
s1=bb(current_frame)
print("before:",s0)
print("after SPACE+LEFT:",s1)
div_moved = s1['D']!=s0['D']
print("divider moved?", div_moved, "| piece moved?", s1['P']!=s0['P'])
if div_moved:
    action(['LEFT','LEFT'])
    s2=bb(current_frame)
    print("after 2 more LEFT:",s2, {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','reward')})
else:
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print("restored:", bb(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def bb(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,ch in [('P','B'),('G','c'),('Y','Y'),('D','S')]:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(0,63) for c in range(0,63) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not cells: out[name]=None; continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        out[name]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    return out
s0=bb(current_frame)
action(['SPACE'])
action(['LEFT'])
s1=bb(current_frame)
print("before:",s0)
print("after SPACE+LEFT:",s1)
div_moved = s1['D']!=s0['D']
print("divider moved?", div_moved, "| piece moved?", s1['P']!=s0['P'])
if div_moved:
    action(['LEFT','LEFT'])
    s2=bb(current_frame)
    print("after 2 more LEFT:",s2, {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','game_over','reward')})
else:
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print("restored:", bb(current_frame))
